## Updates
* 3.11.17 -> 3.11.18
* 3.12.15 -> 3.12.16
* 3.13.17 -> 3.13.18
* 3.14.9  -> 3.14.10
* 3.15.1  -> 3.15.2

## Distribution changes
* On Windows, Python 3.13+ distributions include a `build-details.json` file.
* Linux aarch64 distributions are build with the Cortex-A53 erratum 843419 workaround.
* Linux Python 3.16 distributions do not include dynamic `libgcc_s` helper that are not available on manylinux2014 era distributions. 

## Build system changes
* Artifacts created in pull requests use a lower compression for faster results. Release artifacts continue to use higher compression for smaller sizes.
* On Linux the armv7, ppc64le and s390x distributions are cross-compiled using LLVM. All cross-compiled distributions now use LLVM.
* The `mips` targets are no longer included as build options.
* Modifications to the CPython source is done using patch files rather than Python regex on Windows.
* Dependency paths are passed via MSBuild properties on Windows rather than modifying props files.
* Linux builds use a uniform Debian Trixie base image. Unused images have been removed.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/compare/20261021...20261026
